label: Tax year 2026-27
notes: Tax year 2026-27 under the Income-tax Act, 2025 (in force from 1 April 2026; it replaces "financial year" and "assessment year" with "tax year").

New tax regime, the default under section 202 of the Income-tax Act, 2025 (earlier section 115BAC(1A)): slabs unchanged from FY 2025-26 per the Memorandum explaining the Finance Bill, 2026 ("There is no change proposed in tax rates").

Standard deduction for salaried employees ₹75,000 and rebate up to ₹60,000 when total income does not exceed ₹12,00,000, as announced for FY 2025-26 (PIB, 1 February 2025) and carried forward unchanged.
Marginal relief on the rebate: Income-tax Act, 2025, section 156 (earlier section 87A). For total income just above ₹12,00,000, tax before cess is capped at total income minus ₹12,00,000.
Surcharge (10% above ₹50 lakh, 15% above ₹1 crore, 25% above ₹2 crore, with marginal relief) and 4% health and education cess unchanged per the Finance Bill, 2026 memorandum.
Only the new regime is built in for 2026-27. The old regime's deductions under the 2025 Act have not been verified yet; FY 2025-26 (with the old regime) stays available in the year picker.

officialExamples.note: Salary ₹12,75,000: total income ₹12,00,000, rebate cancels the tax
Salary ₹13,00,000: total income ₹12,25,000, slab tax ₹63,750 capped by marginal relief (section 156) at ₹25,000
Salary ₹13,45,000: total income ₹12,70,000, slab tax ₹70,500 capped at ₹70,000
Salary ₹13,50,000: total income ₹12,75,000, slab tax ₹71,250 (below the ₹75,000 excess, no relief)
